rationale: Correct the existing Pine Gate Renewables record in place to Realized after five bankruptcy sale transactions split the integrated platform and the liquidation plan became effective on April 22, 2026, cancelling all existing equity. Close the existing Generate Capital ownership period, preserve the verified but undisclosed nature of the preferred-equity stake, and do not infer a direct HESTA owner, a successor-platform cap table, or any new successor or project-buyer record.

afterImage.name: Pine Gate Renewables
afterImage.description: Pine Gate Renewables was a U.S. developer and owner-operator of utility-scale solar and storage projects. Founded in 2016, it received a US$500 million growth-and-asset financing commitment from Generate Capital in 2022 and a US$650 million investment involving Generate, HOOPP and HESTA in 2024. Pine Gate entered Chapter 11 in November 2025. Five sale transactions transferred development, operations and project packages between January and April 2026; the liquidation plan became effective on April 22, 2026 and cancelled all existing equity. The historical integrated-platform record is therefore realized. MorningSky Power, ACT Power Services and the separate project-buyer businesses are not treated as continuations of this record.
